dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature from the dorsal ridge, transitioning into a fragmented and jagged spline at the superior terminus.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Irregular and non-uniform pixel boundary; lacks a single radius due to apical tissue loss, presenting as a series of acute, jagged points.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex margin rising from the dorsal ridge with an increasing angular steepness from approximately 25 to 55 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.7:1 ratio between the visible horizontal base and the vertical height from the dorsal ridge to the highest remaining pixel.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major tissue loss and irregular notching at the apex and upper trailing edge; horizontal linear scar/streak visible along the lower lateral base of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique jagged profile of the upper trailing edge and truncated apex morphology.
